acceptance: PlatformPointerBatch or equivalent common envelope exists
common ingress owns ActivePointerRegistry/generation
Down/reuse/Up/Cancel/source-lost behavior is deterministic
provenance/capabilities/contact/tilt survive normalization
PassThroughInputCaptureGate exists
runtime/input has no Arc dependency

obligations.requirement: Equivalent extracted platform facts produce equivalent common normalized traces.
acceptance: fixture corpus covers mouse touch multi-touch history/coalesced pressure tool contact tilt predicted cancel source-lost stale sequence and pointer-id reuse
Web Android Windows Apple fixtures map to the same expected common records when source facts are equivalent

obligations.requirement: Web is only an OS/browser event extractor plus capture/navigation realization.
acceptance: JS no longer owns PointerKey generation
JS no longer allocates Canvas stroke/operation ids
JS no longer directly owns Brush begin/sample/finish lifecycle
JS no longer decides commit/cancel policy
coalesced samples enter one common batch call per PointerEvent
C0 navigation behavior remains unchanged

obligations.requirement: Android MotionEvent ingress uses the common contract and does not use Arc as the canonical Canvas input bus.
acceptance: Java extracts MotionEvent/history/tool/pressure/contact only
history/current samples cross JNI as one common batch per MotionEvent or equivalent bounded batch call
Android platform bridge does not own ActivePointerRegistry
Android platform files do not construct arc_pointer_sample_v0 for canonical Canvas input
Java no longer computes content-space Brush routing or owns Brush session lifecycle

obligations.requirement: Windows WM_POINTER ingress uses the common contract and does not interpret interaction semantics.
acceptance: Windows keeps OS history/pen/contact extraction only
platformPointerAction(ContactDisposition,...) or equivalent semantic interpretation is removed
Windows platform State no longer owns common pointer generation
Windows platform code does not construct Arc pointer batches as canonical Canvas input
commit/release and preview eligibility are driven by common typed results
portable/static contract is reviewer-accessible even when physical Windows qualification is deferred

obligations.requirement: Apple extracted-event records conform to the same common ingress schema without inventing a Product Shell.

coalesced and predicted provenance are distinct
pressure tilt contact cancel/source-lost map to common records
fixture parity passes
